授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students will study the basic technology of semiconductors. More specifically, they will learn about optical devices, power devices, integrated circuits, and other fundermental devices made from semiconductors. Their applications, history, current status, and future of semiconductor devices will be lectured.
advice: Students will learn general knowledge of semiconductor technology, including n-type and p-type semiconductors, diodes and transistors, microfabrication techniques, optoelectronics (optical semiconductors), power semiconductors, and integrated circuits. For integrated circuits, learn about their history, current status, and future. They will learn the meaning of MOS, scaling laws, Moore's law, etc. The future of next-generation artificial intelligence is also a topic of discussion.
requiredKnowledge: This is a liberal arts course for all departments, so there are no specific prior knowledge or skills required.

activityGoals.body: To understand the content of media reports (newspaper articles and news) on semiconductors.
To understand the outline of basic elements such as diodes and transistors.
To have an overview of optical and power semiconductors.
To explain what integrated circuits are.
To explain scaling laws and Moore's Law.

achievementLevels.ideal: Educated understanding of semiconductors in general. The student will have an understanding of individual semiconductors (e.g. diodes, transistors, etc.), logic integrated circuits, memory integrated circuits, etc. To be able to explain in one's own way why integrated circuits have come to be called the brains of all industries. Explain in one's own way why integrated circuits have come to be known as the brains of entire industries.
achievementLevels.standard: To understand the main points about semiconductor-related media articles (newspaper articles, or TV news).

lessons.content:
Fundamentals of semiconductors (how diodes and
transistors work).

Overview of the history of the development of
LEDs (light-emitting diodes) and lasers and
their use in society.

Special lecture on power semiconductors
by a visiting lecturer.

Overview on Integrated Circuits, CMOS, Scaling
Laws, Moore's Law,

History and Current Status of Integrated
Circuits. Why are they called the brains of
all industries?

The Future of Integrated Circuits (Toward Next
Generation Artificial Intelligence and Quantum
Computers)

              Students will study the basic technology of semiconductors. More specifically, they will learn about optical devices, power devices, integrated circuits, and other fundermental devices made from semiconductors. Their applications, history, current status, and future of semiconductor devices will be lectured.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students will learn general knowledge of semiconductor technology, including n-type and p-type semiconductors, diodes and transistors, microfabrication techniques, optoelectronics (optical semiconductors), power semiconductors, and integrated circuits. For integrated circuits, learn about their history, current status, and future. They will learn the meaning of MOS, scaling laws, Moore's law, etc. The future of next-generation artificial intelligence is also a topic of discussion.
